head: f152522b
headSubject: fix(gates): beta evidence computes stale-report-check and honours the command-surface result; REG-152 proof fails when Test-App fails; fast gate says PARTIAL when the canary is skipped; QUAL-62 filed
summary: Manager/NPDevMonitor owner-testing fixes, all UNCOMMITTED on main: engine wording fixed (no E5 jargon, MySQL utf8 claim, SQL Server internals) + per-engine 'on this machine' verdict in npdev db detect (Docker installed/not, Start Docker Desktop button); New-app folder Browse + Create double-submit fix; Run setup live progress (stderr narration forwarded, elapsed timer); npdev dev + run app now run _ops/Start-Environment before boot (ensure_environment, file-logged to avoid pipe hang); generator Start-Environment extracts H2 from the boot jar (H2Server apps could never start their server); doctor warns (not fails) for a stopped NPDev-owned server; Monitor shows not-generated apps as cards with GENERATE & RUN; Versions tab says what is really in use (local checkout vs download); Share tab plain-language intro + reusable ? help popups (help.js); fixed argparse dest collision that made 'npdev ai generate-routine' print top-level help (Scrap Compose) + parser guard test. Owner idea logged: a visible process tracker (status/start/end/who-started/stop-pause-restart) to replace token-costly 'status' polling -- see ProcessTrackerForAI repo + ptrack.
nextStep: 1) Commit the uncommitted work on main (NPDevManager/*, NPDevCli/{npdev_engines,npdev_db_discovery,npdev_cli,dev_loop}.py + tests, NPDevManager/ui/help.js, OperationalRunbookEmitter.java, ledger/items/RUN-37.yml) after scripts/hygiene/clean-workspace-state.ps1, then git push origin main. 2) Run pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/quality/run-kernel-quality-gate.ps1 (via run_digest) to refresh the kernel JaCoCo report -- the generator gate went red ONLY on kernel coverage 58.84% vs floor 71.35% from a stale 2026-10-27 18:27 report; then re-run run-all-gates.ps1. 3) Owner walks the rebuilt Manager (Build/manager-target/release/npdev-manager.exe): Share ? popups, Versions in-use line, Monitor NOT GENERATED card for testH2S_1, Scrap Compose. 4) File ledger items for: shared ArtifactNP sibling dir collision (npdev generate writes <output>/../ArtifactNP, apps in one parent overwrite each other) and run_digest.py UnicodeEncodeError on cp1252 consoles (workaround PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8). testH2S_2 app still running on 8081 + H2Server 9092 (stop: Run tab Stop, npdev db stop --app <testH2S_2-app>).
verified: CLI unit tests: test_db_discovery+test_engines 39 OK, test_dev_loop 13 OK, test_ai_generate_routine 6 OK (incl. parser guard); cargo test 54/54; Manager release build OK; live: npdev run app on testH2S_2 READY exit 0 in 106s, health 200, H2Server started via extracted h2-2.3.232.jar; run-generator-gate.ps1 RED only on kernel coverage ratchet (stale kernel report, kernel untouched) -- generator tests, determinism and out-of-tree rules passed. NOT verified: any Manager screen in a real window; generator change in other engines; T2 all-gates.
